IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Prompt: What do you say into the radio?
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_NotEquipped: Hold the walkie-talkie in your hand or wear the radio on your back: no transmitting from your belt or inventory.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_NoRadio: You need a two-way radio: in your hand or on your back (not on your belt), set down nearby or in your vehicle.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_TooFar: Get closer to the radio's microphone.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_NotInVehicle: Get in the vehicle to use its radio.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Cooldown: Give him a moment to answer.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Busy: Too much chatter on the frequency, try again later.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Spam: You keep talking: catch your breath before the next call.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call: Anyone out there? This is Walt, I got out of Knox. I'm listening on %1. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Darlene: Darlene here, on watch. Anyone hurt or sick out there, call me on %1 and I'll talk you through it. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Cody: Anyone on this band? Don't say your name, don't say where you are. You want to know where the soldiers are, I'm on %1. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Gus: Anyone in the zone with something to trade? I buy what the dead left behind. Serious people only, on %1. Over.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Open: Good evening, Knox County. This is the Night Owl with the confirmed news of the day.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_None: Nothing confirmed reached me today. No news is good news, friends.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_More: And %1 more reports I can't read you tonight.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Close: Keep your doors shut and your radios on. Night Owl, signing off. Over.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Memorial: One more thing. The names of those we lost today, so that somebody says them:
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Mission_success: A job for %1 was carried out, %2.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Mission_abandoned: A job for %1 was given up, %2.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_PowerCut: The power grid went down across the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_WaterCut: The taps ran dry across the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Weather_storm: A thunderstorm broke over the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Weather_tropical_storm: A tropical storm hit the county.
IGUI_RS_ReportInPerson: Objective met: go back to %1 and tell them (Talk), or use Report next to them. The mission succeeds only then; the deadline still runs.
IGUI_RS_ReportRadio: Objective met: call %1 back on its frequency and announce it. The mission succeeds only then; the deadline still runs.
IGUI_RS_ConfirmAccept:
Accept the displayed fixed terms?
The shared timer starts at the first acceptance and is never extended.
IGUI_RS_ConfirmAbandon:
Close this mission for all participants?
Every participant's reputation drops as for a failure; delivered supplies are not refunded.
IGUI_RS_ScoutNotReached: Place not reached yet. Ask the requester for directions; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReached: Place reached (%1). Report to the requester in person.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReport: Report: once the place has been reached, go back to the requester and tell them what you saw (Talk), or use Report next to them.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReachedRadio: Place reached (%1). Report to the voice on its frequency.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReportRadio: Report: once the place has been reached, call the voice back on its frequency and tell it what you saw.
IGUI_RS_ScoutMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the place is somewhere inside, not at its centre.
IGUI_RS_RetrieveMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the body lies in the building, somewhere inside the area, not at its centre.
IGUI_RS_RetrieveNotFound: ID card not found yet. Search the building for the body; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_RS_RetrieveFound: ID card found (%1). Bring it back to the requester.
IGUI_RS_RetrieveReport: Hand-over: near the requester, select Deliver and choose the card taken from the body. Any other ID card is refused.
IGUI_RS_ClearMapZone: The area to clear is circled on your map, around the place: only zombies killed inside the circle count.
IGUI_RS_ClearProgress: Shared count: %1 / %2 zombies killed in the area
IGUI_RS_ClearRule: Only kills by participants count, with a weapon or a vehicle they drive. Zombies that die burning without a recent blow do not count, nor do survivors.
IGUI_RS_ClearReport: Once the count is reached, go back to the requester and tell them (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_RS_RecoverMapZone: An approximate area is circled on your map: the bag lies in the building, somewhere inside the area, not at its centre.
IGUI_RS_RecoverNotFound: Bag not found yet. Search the building; no coordinates are given.
IGUI_RS_RecoverFound: Bag found (%1). Carry it to the depot.
IGUI_RS_RecoverDepotZone: The depot of the group is circled on your map.
IGUI_RS_RecoverReport: Drop the bag on the floor inside the depot circle, or put it in a container there. Any other bag does not count. Once it is there, tell the requester (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_RS_SignalMapZone: The signal area is circled on your map, around the place: the signal must be lit inside the circle.
IGUI_RS_SignalHour: Light it between %1:00 and %2:00 (game time), any day before the deadline.
IGUI_RS_SignalRule: Only a smoke grenade, a road flare or a chemlight of the asked colour lit by a participant counts. Road flares are always red.
IGUI_RS_SignalReport: Once the signal is lit, go back to the requester and tell them (Talk, or Report next to them): the mission succeeds then. Then collect the shared reward near them.
IGUI_RS_Clue_LandmarkNext: There is %1 right next to it, %2.
IGUI_RS_Clue_NoLandmark: There is no shop or public building nearby.
IGUI_RS_Clue_Isolated: It stands on its own, with no other house close by.
IGUI_RS_Clue_FewHouses: There are a few other houses around it.
IGUI_RS_Clue_BuiltUp: It is in a built-up street, among many houses.
IGUI_RS_Clue_TownOutskirts: It is on the outskirts of %1.
IGUI_RS_Clue_TownCountry: It is out in the country, some way from %1.
IGUI_RS_Clue_TownFar: It is out in the countryside, far from any town.
IGUI_RS_RescueSee: I can see you from the window! You are %1. Come on, quickly!
IGUI_RS_RescueSeeGroup: I can see several of you from the window, %1. Come on, quickly!
IGUI_RS_RescueSeeVehicle: I can see a vehicle out there, %1. Is that you?
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_green: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a green smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_red: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a red smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_yellow: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a yellow smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_purple: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a purple smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueNote_Text:
To %1,

You came for us in time. We will never forget it.

We are leaving this place for somewhere safer. We left you what we could spare.

We will keep listening on the radio.

%2
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Waited: We called for help on the radio. We waited %1 days.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_WaitedOne: We called for help on the radio. We waited a whole day.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Group: There were %1 of us in here.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Approach: Once we saw someone come close. They did not stay.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Delivered: Someone left us food. It kept us going a little longer, but it was not enough.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_End: The food is gone and we are too weak to leave. If you find this, we waited as long as we could.
IGUI_RS_UseChat: Target in range. Write on the Say line below (in multiplayer the local /say chat also works).

IGUI_RS_Time: Game time left: %1 min at normal speed. Stops while the game is paused.
IGUI_RS_Reward: Fixed shared reward: %1 × %2. One claim, free sharing.
IGUI_RS_RewardInformation: Reward: information from the voice (a place marked on your map, if it still has one to share).
IGUI_RS_NoRefund: Fixed terms. Personal acceptance. Partial deliveries are never refunded. Failure and abandonment have the same planned penalty.
IGUI_RS_PersonalTrustSeparate: Each person you know also has their own opinion of you, apart from this reputation:
IGUI_RS_RepReason_RequesterKilled: Killed %1, who had entrusted you with a mission
IGUI_RS_NotApplied: Confirmed event, contribution not applied: API unavailable
